cd-tagline: Short tagline in the page header, next to the logo. Wikimedia Categories are the lists of files grouped on Commons and other wikis.
cd-login: Button in the header: log in with a Wikimedia account.
cd-logout: Tooltip and accessible label of the icon button that logs the user out.
cd-language: Accessible label of the interface language selector in the header.
cd-translate: Tooltip and accessible label of the pencil icon next to the language selector. It opens the translation file of the selected language on GitHub.
cd-bot-on: Badge in the header: the account has the "apihighlimits" right (bot or admin speed).
cd-bot-tip-on: Tooltip of the badge when bot speed is on. "Listing" means fetching the list of files of a category.
cd-hero-eyebrow: Small line above the title on the welcome banner (shown to logged out users).
cd-hero-title: Main headline of the welcome banner.
cd-hero-description: Paragraph under the headline of the welcome banner.
cd-hero-step1-title: Title of step 1 of 3 on the welcome banner.
cd-hero-step1-text: Short text under the title of step 1. Reads as a continuation of {{msg-mw|cd-hero-step1-title}}.
cd-hero-step2-title: Title of step 2 of 3 on the welcome banner.
cd-hero-step2-text: Short text under the title of step 2.
cd-hero-step3-title: Title of step 3 of 3 on the welcome banner.
cd-hero-step3-text: Short text under the title of step 3.
cd-footer-made-by: Footer, followed by the name of the author (a link).
cd-browser-unsupported: Warning shown when the browser lacks the File System Access API (Firefox, Safari).
cd-404-code: Small label above the title of the not-found page.
cd-404-home: Link back to the home page, on the not-found page.
cd-resume-title: Title of the box offered on page load when an unfinished download was found in this browser.
cd-resume-subcats:
Shown after the category name. Parameters:
* $1 - number of subcategories
cd-resume-no-root: Shown after the category name when only subcategories are downloaded, not the files directly in the top category.
cd-resume-started:
Parameters:
* $1 - date and time when the download started, already formatted for the user's locale
cd-resume: Button to resume an interrupted download.
cd-resume-rest: Button shown when a download finished with some files failed: resume to retry them.
cd-discard: Button to forget the saved session of an interrupted download.
cd-discard-confirm: Confirmation dialog text shown before discarding the saved session.
cd-login-first: Hint shown beside the disabled Resume button.
cd-login-to-resume: Hint shown under the title of the download panel when Resume is disabled.
cd-failed-title:
Title of the list of failed files. Parameters:
* $1 - number of failed files (used for the plural)
* $2 - the same number formatted with thousands separators
cd-failed-retry-all: Button to queue all failed files again.
cd-failed-export: Button that downloads the list of errors as a file named errors.json. Keep the file name unchanged.
cd-log-saved: Heading of the list of the last files saved.
cd-log-saved-empty: Shown when the list of saved files is empty.
cd-log-upcoming: Heading of the list of the next files to be downloaded.
cd-log-upcoming-empty: Shown when the queue is empty.
cd-phase-running: Title of the download panel while downloading.
cd-phase-stopping: Title of the download panel while pausing.
cd-phase-stopped: Title of the download panel when paused.
cd-phase-done: Title of the download panel when the download finished.
cd-phase-paused-auth: Title of the download panel when the login expired.
cd-phase-error: Title of the download panel after an error.
cd-phase-idle: Title of the download panel before anything started.
cd-pausing-note: Note shown while the download is pausing. The README is a file written in the download folder.
cd-folder-fallback: Used instead of the folder name when it is unknown, in "saved to $3".
cd-finish-summary:
Summary on the success banner. Parameters:
* $1 - number of files (used for the plural)
* $2 - the same number formatted
* $3 - folder name
cd-finish-summary-timed:
Same as {{msg-mw|cd-finish-summary}} with the duration. Parameters:
* $1 - number of files (plural)
* $2 - the same number formatted
* $3 - folder name
* $4 - duration, such as "3 min 05 s"
cd-finish-failed:
Parameters:
* $1 - number of files (plural)
* $2 - the same number formatted
cd-stat-to-retry:
Hint under a tile. Parameters:
* $1 - number of failed files
cd-stat-no-failures: Hint under a tile when no file failed.
cd-stat-time-taken: Label of a statistics tile: total duration of the finished download.
cd-stat-saved-in: Label of a statistics tile: the folder where files were saved.
cd-stat-of-total:
Hint under {{msg-mw|cd-stat-saved-so-far}}. Parameters:
* $1 - approximate total number of files
cd-stat-speed: Label of a statistics tile: current download speed.
cd-stat-time-left: Label of a statistics tile: estimated remaining time.
cd-stat-time-spent: Label of a statistics tile: time spent so far.
cd-stat-waiting: Label of a statistics tile: files queued and not yet downloaded.
cd-counter-rest:
Follows a large number in the same line, so the whole reads "1,234 of ~5,000 files saved". Parameters:
* $1 - approximate total number of files
cd-counter-listing:
Parameters:
* $1 - number of files found so far
cd-progress-label: Accessible label of the progress bar.
cd-readme-note: Follows "README.md —" in the title of an expandable section.
cd-step1-title: Title of step 1 of the page.
cd-step1-text: Help text under the title of step 1. "es:wp:" is a literal prefix selecting the Spanish Wikipedia: do not translate it. Keep “Category:” as the English namespace name.
cd-category-aria: Accessible label of the category input field.
cd-no-match: Shown in the suggestions menu when nothing matches.
cd-check: Button that looks up the typed category.
cd-checking: Same button while the lookup is running.
cd-tab-hint: Hint under the empty category field. "Tab" is the keyboard key.
cd-category-summary:
Parameters:
* $1 - category name
* $2 - number of files (plural)
* $3 - the same number formatted
cd-one-level: Small note after {{msg-mw|cd-include-subcats}}: only direct subcategories are included.
cd-selected-count:
Parameters:
* $1 - number selected
* $2 - total number of categories in the list
cd-select-none: Link that unselects all categories of the list.
cd-select-all: Link that selects all categories of the list.
cd-top-category: Badge on the first row of the list: the category the user typed.
cd-row-files:
Parameters:
* $1 - number of files (plural)
* $2 - the same number formatted
cd-no-subcats: Shown when the category has no subcategories.
cd-total-estimate:
Parameters:
* $1 - estimated total number of files, formatted
cd-nothing-selected: Hint shown when no category is ticked.
cd-step2-title: Title of step 2 of the page.
cd-step2-text: Help text under the title of step 2. CategoryDownloader is the tool's name: do not translate it.
cd-start: Main button: opens a folder picker, then starts the download.
cd-copy-link: Button copying a link to the current category and options.
cd-running-note: Shown beside the start button while a download runs.
cd-check-first: Shown beside the start button when no category has been checked.
cd-sidecars-label: Locked checkbox label. ".json" is a file extension.
cd-sidecars-note: Explanation under the locked checkbox. Wikimedia content requires attribution.
cd-filter-title-label: Small label above the title filter input.
cd-filter-title-note: Tooltip of the title filter input. "File:" is the English namespace name.
cd-filter-regex: Tooltip and accessible label of the small ".*" toggle beside the title filter: when on, the title is read as a regular expression.
cd-filter-count-note: Note shown when a filter is active.
cd-advanced-summary: Summary (title) of a collapsible section holding the two settings that set how fast files are downloaded: pause between files and number of simultaneous downloads. "Pace" means rhythm or tempo.
cd-delay-label: Label of a number input. "ms" means milliseconds.
cd-concurrency-label: Label of a number input: how many files are downloaded in parallel.
cd-step3-title: Title of step 3 of the page.
cd-step3-text: Help text under the title of step 3.
cd-step3-placeholder: Placeholder in step 3. The quoted text must match {{msg-mw|cd-start}}.
cd-error-not-exist:
Error shown when the category does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the category name
cd-error-already-running: Error shown when another browser tab runs a download.
cd-error-pick-folder: Error shown when the remembered folder is not available.
cd-error-permission: Error shown when the user refuses folder access.
cd-filter-dates: Tooltip of the two date inputs: they filter on the date the file was uploaded.
cd-filter-date-placeholder: Placeholder of the date inputs: the order of year, month and day, written the way your language abbreviates them. Year first, then month, then day, separated by slashes. Only digits and slashes are typed.
cd-filter-date-invalid: Error shown when a typed date is not valid. Use the same abbreviation as {{msg-mw|cd-filter-date-placeholder}}.
cd-filter-start: Small label above the first date input: first day to include (inclusive). Read together with {{msg-mw|cd-filter-dates}}.
cd-filter-end: Small label above the second date input: last day to include (inclusive).
cd-concurrency-warning: Tooltip and accessible label of a warning icon shown when 4 or more simultaneous downloads are chosen. Wikimedia's robot policy asks for at most 2 concurrent media downloads.
